candidate.answerReason: Among 19 ordered name lengths, the median is the 10th. The graph shows seven three-letter names followed by three four-letter names, so the 10th length is 4.

methods.label: Locate the middle name
methods.explanation:
Arrange the \(19\) name lengths from shortest to longest. The median is the \(10\)th length, because it has \(9\) lengths before it and \(9\) after it.

The graph shows \(7\) three-letter names and \(3\) four-letter names. Thus positions \(1\) through \(7\) have length \(3\), and positions \(8\) through \(10\) have length \(4\). The \(10\)th length is therefore \(\boxed{4}\) letters, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
methods.levelReason: Reading bar frequencies and locating the middle observation require only elementary counting and the definition of median.
